title: Fix unmask for `/sys/devices/virtual/powercap`
body:
generateSpec() was appending powercap to linux.maskedPaths after specgen had already applied defaults and unmask, so unmask never fully worked for that path (and it could show up twice by default).

Drop the old addMaskedPaths hook; powercap is already in DefaultMaskedPaths().

Fixes: https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/30036

Fix --security-opt unmask for /sys/devices/virtual/powercap
